title: Deploy private Tiny-D1 inference worker and authorize backend-only predictions
baseCommit: f1c9570f (KAN-178 VMM-10 head; composes VMM-10 registry + VMM-07 model + VMM-05 baseline)
whatBuilt: BACKEND-ONLY AUTHORIZATION: predictions served ONLY to the registered backend service identity within its allowed scopes; end-user/anonymous callers and out-of-scope workspaces denied — NO public direct model endpoint; the worker cannot even be constructed without a backend-service identity

VERSIONED INFERENCE ON A PINNED APPROVED MODEL: deploy loads the pinned version from the VMM-10 registry (unapproved versions refused at deploy); responses carry modelId/version/digest; requests referencing a version that no longer matches the served pin are refused as stale (after rollback/redeploy)

DEADLINE + CANCELLATION: every request carries a deadline including caller-side queue time (deterministic); exhausted budget yields a defined CANCELLED response (never a late result); cancel() acknowledgment defined
SAFE FALLBACK: when the model abstains (confidence floor / OOD), the worker falls back to the ACCEPTED baseline (VMM-05 policy teacher) and marks response.fallback — never to an unvalidated path

WEIGHTS NEVER EXPOSED: no weights in any response path; weightsExposed false; actual worker request/response proven against a REAL trained checkpoint (trained from scratch in-test, registered + approved through the VMM-10 registry)

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 100/100 pass (91 previous + 9 serving)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: The worker is the serving CONTRACT; the actual hosted deployment (GCP/ingress, latency under load, real network) remains a separate hosted gate and is not claimed closed. No public endpoint is exposed. Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
